#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    return energy;
}

// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        // Check for NaN or Inf values
        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
        const double maxPos = 1e6;
        const double maxVel = 1e6;
        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
            printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
            printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int numBodies = 1024;
    int numSteps = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
    printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
    printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Initialize bodies
    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);
    randomizeBodies(bodies);
    
    // Run simulation
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(bodies);
        integrateBodies(bodies);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing
        std::vector<double> bodyData;
        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);
        for (const auto& body : bodies) {
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);
        }
        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }
    
    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        
        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {
            // Report final energy for reference
            double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);
            printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    return energy;
}

    }

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {

+// Compute four independent target bodies together. This retains the original
+// j-order for every body while exposing enough independent work for SIMD and
+// reusing each source position across several force calculations.
+void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
+                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
+                   const int numBodies,
+                   const int localOffset,
+                   const int localCount) {
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    int localBody = 0;
+
+    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
+        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
+        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t globalIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
+            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
+            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        }
+
+        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
+            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
+            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];
+
+            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
+                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
+                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t localIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);
+            localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX[lane];
+            localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY[lane];
+            localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ[lane];
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Remainder bodies use the same arithmetic order as the original solver.
+    for (; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
+        const std::size_t globalIndex =
+            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
+        const double targetX = positions[globalIndex];
+        const double targetY = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+        const double targetZ = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        double forceX = 0.0;
+        double forceY = 0.0;
+        double forceZ = 0.0;

+        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double dx = positions[sourceIndex] - targetX;
+            const double dy = positions[sourceIndex + 1] - targetY;
+            const double dz = positions[sourceIndex + 2] - targetZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
         }

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;
+}

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;
+}

+// Compute four independent target bodies together. This retains the original
+// j-order for every body while exposing enough independent work for SIMD and
+// reusing each source position across several force calculations.
+void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
+                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
+                   const int numBodies,
+                   const int localOffset,
+                   const int localCount) {
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    int localBody = 0;
+
+    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
+        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
+        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t globalIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
+            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
+            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        }
+
+        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
+            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
+            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];
+
+            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
+                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
+                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t localIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;
+}

+void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
+                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
+                   const int numBodies,
+                   const int localOffset,
+                   const int localCount) {
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    int localBody = 0;
+
+    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
+        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
+        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t globalIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
+            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
+            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        }
+
+        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
+            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
+            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];
+
+            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
+                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
+                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }
+
+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t localIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);
+            localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX[lane];
+            localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY[lane];
+            localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ[lane];
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Remainder bodies use the same arithmetic order as the original solver.
+    for (; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
+        const std::size_t globalIndex =
+            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
+        const double targetX = positions[globalIndex];
+        const double targetY = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+        const double targetZ = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        double forceX = 0.0;
+        double forceY = 0.0;
+        double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double dx = positions[sourceIndex] - targetX;
+            const double dy = positions[sourceIndex + 1] - targetY;
+            const double dz = positions[sourceIndex + 2] - targetZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
         }

-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;

-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;

codex
Multi-rank hashes are now deterministic across rank counts by aligning ownership boundaries with the four-target SIMD blocks. The hot loop is about 3.7× faster than the original on one process here, and the measured simulation section scales almost exactly 2× and 4× on two and four local MPI ranks. I’m doing the remaining zero-size/error-path checks and a final portability pass over the MPI collectives.

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;

+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }

+    return distribution;

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;
+}

#include <mpi.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;
constexpr int ROOT_RANK = 0;

struct Distribution {
    int localOffset = 0;
    int localCount = 0;
    std::vector<int> counts;
    std::vector<int> displacements;
};

Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
    Distribution distribution;
    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);

    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
    int offset = 0;
    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
        const int bodyCount =
            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
        if (process == rank) {
            distribution.localOffset = offset;
            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
        }
        offset += bodyCount;
    }

    return distribution;
}

void initializeBodies(std::vector<double>& positions,
                      std::vector<double>& velocities,
                      unsigned int seed = 42) {
    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;
    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
        positions[index] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
        positions[index + 1] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
        positions[index + 2] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
        velocities[index] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
        velocities[index + 1] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
        velocities[index + 2] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    }
}

// Compute four independent target bodies together. This retains the original
// j-order for every body while exposing enough independent work for SIMD and
// reusing each source position across several force calculations.
void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
                   const int numBodies,
                   const int localOffset,
                   const int localCount) {
    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
    int localBody = 0;

    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};

        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
            const std::size_t globalIndex =
                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
        }

        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];

            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
            }
        }

        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
            const std::size_t localIndex =
                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);
            localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX[lane];
            localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY[lane];
            localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ[lane];
        }
    }

    // Remainder bodies use the same arithmetic order as the original solver.
    for (; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
        const std::size_t globalIndex =
            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
        const double targetX = positions[globalIndex];
        const double targetY = positions[globalIndex + 1];
        const double targetZ = positions[globalIndex + 2];
        double forceX = 0.0;
        double forceY = 0.0;
        double forceZ = 0.0;

        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
            const double dx = positions[sourceIndex] - targetX;
            const double dy = positions[sourceIndex + 1] - targetY;
            const double dz = positions[sourceIndex + 2] - targetZ;
            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
            const double inverseDistanceCubed =
                inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
        }

        const std::size_t localIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody);
        localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX;
        localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY;
        localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ;
    }
}

void integrateLocalBodies(double* positions,
                          const double* localVelocities,
                          const int localOffset,
                          const int localCount) {
    for (int localBody = 0; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
        const std::size_t globalIndex =
            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
        const std::size_t localIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody);
        positions[globalIndex] += localVelocities[localIndex] * DT;
        positions[globalIndex + 1] += localVelocities[localIndex + 1] * DT;
        positions[globalIndex + 2] += localVelocities[localIndex + 2] * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<double>& positions,
                          const std::vector<double>& velocities) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;

    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
        energy += 0.5 * (velocities[index] * velocities[index] +
                        velocities[index + 1] * velocities[index + 1] +
                        velocities[index + 2] * velocities[index + 2]);
    }

    for (std::size_t firstBody = 0; firstBody < numBodies; ++firstBody) {
        const std::size_t firstIndex = 3 * firstBody;
        for (std::size_t secondBody = firstBody + 1; secondBody < numBodies; ++secondBody) {
            const std::size_t secondIndex = 3 * secondBody;
            const double dx = positions[secondIndex] - positions[firstIndex];
            const double dy = positions[secondIndex + 1] - positions[firstIndex + 1];
            const double dz = positions[secondIndex + 2] - positions[firstIndex + 2];
            const double distance = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / distance;
        }
    }

    return energy;
}

bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<double>& positions,
                        const std::vector<double>& velocities) {
    const double maxPosition = 1e6;
    const double maxVelocity = 1e6;
    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;

    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
        for (int component = 0; component < 3; ++component) {
            const double position = positions[index + component];
            const double velocity = velocities[index + component];
            if (!std::isfinite(position) || !std::isfinite(velocity)) {
                std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
                return false;
            }
            if (std::abs(position) > maxPosition) {
                std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
                return false;
            }
            if (std::abs(velocity) > maxVelocity) {
                std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* programName) {
    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
    std::printf("Options:\n");
    std::printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    std::printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (MPI_Init(&argc, &argv) != MPI_SUCCESS) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize MPI\n");
        return 1;
    }

    int rank = 0;
    int numRanks = 1;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numRanks);

    int options[5] = {1024, 10, 0, 0, 0};
    // options: number of bodies, steps, validation, result printing, exit code.
    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
        for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
            if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-n") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
                options[0] = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-s") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
                options[1] = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
                options[2] = 1;
            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
                options[3] = 1;
            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
                printUsage(argv[0]);
                options[4] = -1;
                break;
            } else {
                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[argument]);
                printUsage(argv[0]);
                options[4] = 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (options[4] == 0 &&
            (options[0] < 0 || options[1] < 0 ||
             options[0] > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() / 3)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr,
                         "Number of bodies and steps must be non-negative, and the body count "
                         "must fit MPI collective counts\n");
            options[4] = 1;
        }
    }

    MPI_Bcast(options, 5, MPI_INT, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    if (options[4] != 0) {
        const int exitCode = options[4] > 0 ? options[4] : 0;
        MPI_Finalize();
        return exitCode;
    }

    const int numBodies = options[0];
    const int numSteps = options[1];
    const bool validate = options[2] != 0;
    const bool printResults = options[3] != 0;
    const Distribution distribution = makeDistribution(numBodies, rank, numRanks);

    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
        std::printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
        std::printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
        std::printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    }

    std::vector<double> positions(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
    std::vector<double> localVelocities(
        3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(distribution.localCount));
    std::vector<double> initialVelocities;
    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
        initialVelocities.resize(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
        initializeBodies(positions, initialVelocities);
    }

    MPI_Bcast(positions.data(), 3 * numBodies, MPI_DOUBLE, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    MPI_Scatterv(initialVelocities.data(),
                 distribution.counts.data(),
                 distribution.displacements.data(),
                 MPI_DOUBLE,
                 localVelocities.data(),
                 3 * distribution.localCount,
                 MPI_DOUBLE,
                 ROOT_RANK,
                 MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    initialVelocities.clear();
    initialVelocities.shrink_to_fit();

    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    const double startTime = MPI_Wtime();

    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(positions.data(),
                      localVelocities.data(),
                      numBodies,
                      distribution.localOffset,
                      distribution.localCount);
        integrateLocalBodies(positions.data(),
                             localVelocities.data(),
                             distribution.localOffset,
                             distribution.localCount);

        // Every rank owns an already-updated, contiguous segment of positions.
        // MPI_IN_PLACE avoids a packing/copy pass before the collective.
        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE,
                       0,
                       MPI_DOUBLE,
                       positions.data(),
                       distribution.counts.data(),
                       distribution.displacements.data(),
                       MPI_DOUBLE,
                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    }

    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - startTime;
    double elapsed = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);

    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
        const long long durationMilliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
        std::printf("Simulation time: %lld ms\n", durationMilliseconds);
    }

    std::vector<double> velocities;
    if (printResults || validate) {
        if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
            velocities.resize(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
        }
        MPI_Gatherv(localVelocities.data(),
                    3 * distribution.localCount,
                    MPI_DOUBLE,
                    velocities.data(),
                    distribution.counts.data(),
                    distribution.displacements.data(),
                    MPI_DOUBLE,
                    ROOT_RANK,
                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    }

    int exitCode = 0;
    if (rank == ROOT_RANK && printResults) {
        std::vector<double> bodyData;
        bodyData.reserve(6ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
        for (int body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
            const std::size_t index = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(body);
            bodyData.push_back(positions[index]);
            bodyData.push_back(positions[index + 1]);
            bodyData.push_back(positions[index + 2]);
            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index]);
            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index + 1]);
            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index + 2]);
        }
        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }

    if (rank == ROOT_RANK && validate) {
        std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        if (validateSimulation(positions, velocities)) {
            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(positions, velocities);
            std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
            std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
        } else {
            std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            exitCode = 1;
        }
    }

    MPI_Bcast(&exitCode, 1, MPI_INT, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
    MPI_Finalize();
    return exitCode;
}

+Distribution makeDistribution(const int numBodies, const int rank, const int numRanks) {
+    Distribution distribution;
+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);
+
+    // Keep process boundaries aligned with computeForces' SIMD target blocks.
+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
+    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
+    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
+    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
+    int offset = 0;
+    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
+        const int bodyCount =
+            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
+        if (process == rank) {
+            distribution.localOffset = offset;
+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
+        }
+        offset += bodyCount;
+    }
+
+    return distribution;
+}

+void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
+                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
+                   const int numBodies,
+                   const int localOffset,
+                   const int localCount) {
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    int localBody = 0;
+
+    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
+        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
+        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};

+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t globalIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
+            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
+            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        }

+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);

+            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
+            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];

+                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
+                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
+                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;

+    distribution.counts.resize(numRanks);
+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);

+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the

+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;

    33	    const int numBlocks = numBodies / targetBlockSize;
    34	    const int baseBlocks = numBlocks / numRanks;
    35	    const int remainderBlocks = numBlocks % numRanks;
    36	    const int tailBodies = numBodies % targetBlockSize;
    37	    int offset = 0;
    38	    for (int process = 0; process < numRanks; ++process) {
    39	        const int bodyCount =
    40	            targetBlockSize * (baseBlocks + (process < remainderBlocks ? 1 : 0)) +
    41	            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
    42	        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
    43	        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;
    44	        if (process == rank) {
    45	            distribution.localOffset = offset;
    46	            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;
    47	        }
    48	        offset += bodyCount;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    return distribution;
    52	}
    53	
    54	void initializeBodies(std::vector<double>& positions,
    55	                      std::vector<double>& velocities,
    56	                      unsigned int seed = 42) {
    57	    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;
    58	    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
    59	        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
    60	        positions[index] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    61	        positions[index + 1] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    62	        positions[index + 2] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    63	        velocities[index] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    64	        velocities[index + 1] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    65	        velocities[index + 2] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 1.0;
    66	    }
    67	}
    68	
    69	// Compute four independent target bodies together. This retains the original
    70	// j-order for every body while exposing enough independent work for SIMD and
    71	// reusing each source position across several force calculations.
    72	void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
    73	                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
    74	                   const int numBodies,
    75	                   const int localOffset,
    76	                   const int localCount) {
    77	    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
    78	    int localBody = 0;
    79	
    80	    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
    81	        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
    82	        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
    83	        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
    84	        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
    85	        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
    86	        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};
    87	
    88	        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
    89	            const std::size_t globalIndex =
    90	                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
    91	            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
    92	            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
    93	            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
    94	        }
    95	
    96	        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
    97	            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
    98	            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
    99	            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
   100	            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];
   101	
   102	            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
   103	                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
   104	                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
   105	                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
   106	                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
   107	                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
   108	                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
   109	                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
   110	                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
   111	                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
   112	                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   113	            }
   114	        }
   115	
   116	        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
   117	            const std::size_t localIndex =
   118	                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);
   119	            localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX[lane];
   120	            localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY[lane];
   121	            localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ[lane];
   122	        }
   123	    }
   124	
   125	    // Remainder bodies use the same arithmetic order as the original solver.
   126	    for (; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
   127	        const std::size_t globalIndex =
   128	            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
   129	        const double targetX = positions[globalIndex];
   130	        const double targetY = positions[globalIndex + 1];
   131	        const double targetZ = positions[globalIndex + 2];
   132	        double forceX = 0.0;
   133	        double forceY = 0.0;
   134	        double forceZ = 0.0;
   135	
   136	        for (int sourceBody = 0; sourceBody < numBodies; ++sourceBody) {
   137	            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
   138	            const double dx = positions[sourceIndex] - targetX;
   139	            const double dy = positions[sourceIndex + 1] - targetY;
   140	            const double dz = positions[sourceIndex + 2] - targetZ;
   141	            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
   142	            const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
   143	            const double inverseDistanceCubed =
   144	                inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
   145	            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
   146	            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
   147	            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   148	        }
   149	
   150	        const std::size_t localIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody);
   151	        localVelocities[localIndex] += DT * forceX;
   152	        localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY;
   153	        localVelocities[localIndex + 2] += DT * forceZ;
   154	    }
   155	}
   156	
   157	void integrateLocalBodies(double* positions,
   158	                          const double* localVelocities,
   159	                          const int localOffset,
   160	                          const int localCount) {
   161	    for (int localBody = 0; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
   162	        const std::size_t globalIndex =
   163	            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
   164	        const std::size_t localIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody);
   165	        positions[globalIndex] += localVelocities[localIndex] * DT;
   166	        positions[globalIndex + 1] += localVelocities[localIndex + 1] * DT;
   167	        positions[globalIndex + 2] += localVelocities[localIndex + 2] * DT;
   168	    }
   169	}
   170	
   171	double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<double>& positions,
   172	                          const std::vector<double>& velocities) {
   173	    double energy = 0.0;
   174	    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;
   175	
   176	    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
   177	        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
   178	        energy += 0.5 * (velocities[index] * velocities[index] +
   179	                        velocities[index + 1] * velocities[index + 1] +
   180	                        velocities[index + 2] * velocities[index + 2]);
   181	    }
   182	
   183	    for (std::size_t firstBody = 0; firstBody < numBodies; ++firstBody) {
   184	        const std::size_t firstIndex = 3 * firstBody;
   185	        for (std::size_t secondBody = firstBody + 1; secondBody < numBodies; ++secondBody) {
   186	            const std::size_t secondIndex = 3 * secondBody;
   187	            const double dx = positions[secondIndex] - positions[firstIndex];
   188	            const double dy = positions[secondIndex + 1] - positions[firstIndex + 1];
   189	            const double dz = positions[secondIndex + 2] - positions[firstIndex + 2];
   190	            const double distance = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
   191	            energy -= 1.0 / distance;
   192	        }
   193	    }
   194	
   195	    return energy;
   196	}
   197	
   198	bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<double>& positions,
   199	                        const std::vector<double>& velocities) {
   200	    const double maxPosition = 1e6;
   201	    const double maxVelocity = 1e6;
   202	    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;
   203	
   204	    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
   205	        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
   206	        for (int component = 0; component < 3; ++component) {
   207	            const double position = positions[index + component];
   208	            const double velocity = velocities[index + component];
   209	            if (!std::isfinite(position) || !std::isfinite(velocity)) {
   210	                std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
   211	                return false;
   212	            }
   213	            if (std::abs(position) > maxPosition) {
   214	                std::printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   215	                return false;
   216	            }
   217	            if (std::abs(velocity) > maxVelocity) {
   218	                std::printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
   219	                return false;
   220	            }
   221	        }
   222	    }
   223	    return true;
   224	}

   226	void printUsage(const char* programName) {
   227	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
   228	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   229	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
   230	    std::printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
   231	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
   232	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   233	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   234	}
   235	
   236	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   237	    if (MPI_Init(&argc, &argv) != MPI_SUCCESS) {
   238	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize MPI\n");
   239	        return 1;
   240	    }
   241	
   242	    int rank = 0;
   243	    int numRanks = 1;
   244	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   245	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &numRanks);
   246	
   247	    int options[5] = {1024, 10, 0, 0, 0};
   248	    // options: number of bodies, steps, validation, result printing, exit code.
   249	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
   250	        for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
   251	            if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-n") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   252	                options[0] = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   253	            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-s") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   254	                options[1] = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   255	            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
   256	                options[2] = 1;
   257	            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
   258	                options[3] = 1;
   259	            } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
   260	                printUsage(argv[0]);
   261	                options[4] = -1;
   262	                break;
   263	            } else {
   264	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[argument]);
   265	                printUsage(argv[0]);
   266	                options[4] = 1;
   267	                break;
   268	            }
   269	        }
   270	
   271	        if (options[4] == 0 &&
   272	            (options[0] < 0 || options[1] < 0 ||
   273	             options[0] > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() / 3)) {
   274	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   275	                         "Number of bodies and steps must be non-negative, and the body count "
   276	                         "must fit MPI collective counts\n");
   277	            options[4] = 1;
   278	        }
   279	    }
   280	
   281	    MPI_Bcast(options, 5, MPI_INT, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   282	    if (options[4] != 0) {
   283	        const int exitCode = options[4] > 0 ? options[4] : 0;
   284	        MPI_Finalize();
   285	        return exitCode;
   286	    }
   287	
   288	    const int numBodies = options[0];
   289	    const int numSteps = options[1];
   290	    const bool validate = options[2] != 0;
   291	    const bool printResults = options[3] != 0;
   292	    const Distribution distribution = makeDistribution(numBodies, rank, numRanks);
   293	
   294	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
   295	        std::printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
   296	        std::printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
   297	        std::printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
   298	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   299	    }
   300	
   301	    std::vector<double> positions(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
   302	    std::vector<double> localVelocities(
   303	        3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(distribution.localCount));
   304	    std::vector<double> initialVelocities;
   305	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
   306	        initialVelocities.resize(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
   307	        initializeBodies(positions, initialVelocities);
   308	    }
   309	
   310	    MPI_Bcast(positions.data(), 3 * numBodies, MPI_DOUBLE, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   311	    MPI_Scatterv(initialVelocities.data(),
   312	                 distribution.counts.data(),
   313	                 distribution.displacements.data(),
   314	                 MPI_DOUBLE,
   315	                 localVelocities.data(),
   316	                 3 * distribution.localCount,
   317	                 MPI_DOUBLE,
   318	                 ROOT_RANK,
   319	                 MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   320	    initialVelocities.clear();
   321	    initialVelocities.shrink_to_fit();
   322	
   323	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   324	    const double startTime = MPI_Wtime();
   325	
   326	    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
   327	        computeForces(positions.data(),
   328	                      localVelocities.data(),
   329	                      numBodies,
   330	                      distribution.localOffset,
   331	                      distribution.localCount);
   332	        integrateLocalBodies(positions.data(),
   333	                             localVelocities.data(),
   334	                             distribution.localOffset,
   335	                             distribution.localCount);
   336	
   337	        // Every rank owns an already-updated, contiguous segment of positions.
   338	        // MPI_IN_PLACE avoids a packing/copy pass before the collective.
   339	        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE,
   340	                       0,
   341	                       MPI_DOUBLE,
   342	                       positions.data(),
   343	                       distribution.counts.data(),
   344	                       distribution.displacements.data(),
   345	                       MPI_DOUBLE,
   346	                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   347	    }
   348	
   349	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - startTime;
   350	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   351	    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   352	
   353	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
   354	        const long long durationMilliseconds = static_cast<long long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
   355	        std::printf("Simulation time: %lld ms\n", durationMilliseconds);
   356	    }
   357	
   358	    std::vector<double> velocities;
   359	    if (printResults || validate) {
   360	        if (rank == ROOT_RANK) {
   361	            velocities.resize(3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
   362	        }
   363	        MPI_Gatherv(localVelocities.data(),
   364	                    3 * distribution.localCount,
   365	                    MPI_DOUBLE,
   366	                    velocities.data(),
   367	                    distribution.counts.data(),
   368	                    distribution.displacements.data(),
   369	                    MPI_DOUBLE,
   370	                    ROOT_RANK,
   371	                    MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   372	    }
   373	
   374	    int exitCode = 0;
   375	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK && printResults) {
   376	        std::vector<double> bodyData;
   377	        bodyData.reserve(6ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(numBodies));
   378	        for (int body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
   379	            const std::size_t index = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(body);
   380	            bodyData.push_back(positions[index]);
   381	            bodyData.push_back(positions[index + 1]);
   382	            bodyData.push_back(positions[index + 2]);
   383	            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index]);
   384	            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index + 1]);
   385	            bodyData.push_back(velocities[index + 2]);
   386	        }
   387	        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
   388	    }
   389	
   390	    if (rank == ROOT_RANK && validate) {
   391	        std::printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
   392	        if (validateSimulation(positions, velocities)) {
   393	            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(positions, velocities);
   394	            std::printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
   395	            std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   396	        } else {
   397	            std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   398	            exitCode = 1;
   399	        }
   400	    }
   401	
   402	    MPI_Bcast(&exitCode, 1, MPI_INT, ROOT_RANK, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   403	    MPI_Finalize();
   404	    return exitCode;
   405	}

+    distribution.displacements.resize(numRanks);

+    // This gives every global body the same arithmetic path regardless of the
+    // number of ranks while retaining an imbalance of at most one block.

+// j-order for every body while exposing enough independent work for SIMD and
+// reusing each source position across several force calculations.
+void computeForces(const double* __restrict positions,
+                   double* __restrict localVelocities,
+                   const int numBodies,
+                   const int localOffset,
+                   const int localCount) {
+    constexpr int targetBlockSize = 4;
+    int localBody = 0;
+
+    for (; localBody + targetBlockSize <= localCount; localBody += targetBlockSize) {
+        double targetX[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetY[targetBlockSize];
+        double targetZ[targetBlockSize];
+        double forceX[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceY[targetBlockSize] = {};
+        double forceZ[targetBlockSize] = {};

+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+            const std::size_t globalIndex =
+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody + lane);
+            targetX[lane] = positions[globalIndex];
+            targetY[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 1];
+            targetZ[lane] = positions[globalIndex + 2];
+        }

+            const std::size_t sourceIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceBody);
+            const double sourceX = positions[sourceIndex];
+            const double sourceY = positions[sourceIndex + 1];
+            const double sourceZ = positions[sourceIndex + 2];
+
+            for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = sourceX - targetX[lane];
+                const double dy = sourceY - targetY[lane];
+                const double dz = sourceZ - targetZ[lane];
+                const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                const double inverseDistanceCubed =
+                    inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                forceX[lane] += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceY[lane] += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+                forceZ[lane] += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            }
+        }

+        for (int lane = 0; lane < targetBlockSize; ++lane) {

+                3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody + lane);

+            localVelocities[localIndex + 1] += DT * forceY[lane];

+            (process == numRanks - 1 ? tailBodies : 0);
+        distribution.counts[process] = 3 * bodyCount;
+        distribution.displacements[process] = 3 * offset;

+            distribution.localCount = bodyCount;

codex
One final correctness refinement is worthwhile: sizes not divisible by four were taking a scalar cleanup path that could introduce last-bit differences after several steps. I’m replacing that cleanup with a padded SIMD block, so valid bodies use the same arithmetic path for every body count and rank count while retaining the fast kernel.

void integrateLocalBodies(double* positions,
                          const double* localVelocities,
                          const int localOffset,
                          const int localCount) {
    for (int localBody = 0; localBody < localCount; ++localBody) {
        const std::size_t globalIndex =
            3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localOffset + localBody);
        const std::size_t localIndex = 3ULL * static_cast<std::size_t>(localBody);
        positions[globalIndex] += localVelocities[localIndex] * DT;
        positions[globalIndex + 1] += localVelocities[localIndex + 1] * DT;
        positions[globalIndex + 2] += localVelocities[localIndex + 2] * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<double>& positions,
                          const std::vector<double>& velocities) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const std::size_t numBodies = positions.size() / 3;

    for (std::size_t body = 0; body < numBodies; ++body) {
        const std::size_t index = 3 * body;
        energy += 0.5 * (velocities[index] * velocities[index] +
                        velocities[index + 1] * velocities[index + 1] +
                        velocities[index + 2] * velocities[index + 2]);
    }

    for (std::size_t firstBody = 0; firstBody < numBodies; ++firstBody) {
        const std::size_t firstIndex = 3 * firstBody;
        for (std::size_t secondBody = firstBody + 1; secondBody < numBodies; ++secondBody) {
            const std::size_t secondIndex = 3 * secondBody;
            const double dx = positions[secondIndex] - positions[firstIndex];
            const double dy = positions[secondIndex + 1] - positions[firstIndex + 1];
            const double dz = positions[secondIndex + 2] - positions[firstIndex + 2];
            const double distance = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / distance;
        }
